args: For EACH numbered alternative, assess align_i separately from descent_i. align_i authorizes only moving the empty, still-open hand to its high pad target and markedly side-entry orientation. Check the visible swept hand/palm/fingers against counter, package, bowl and obstacles. descent_i addresses the later side-entry lowering and whether the open fingers can actually straddle these local walls. The outer-span screen is only necessary, NOT proof of an open aperture or palm clearance. Mark an observed palm/counter obstruction blocked; never call hidden space clear. Unknown descent does not invalidate an independently clear high alignment, but an established descent obstruction must not be postponed.

top_ids: t0: inner curl of the large initial capital C in the printed word Cream, toward the exposed short end.
t1: inner curl of the large initial capital C in the printed word Cheese, below Cream in this view.
t2: initial F of the smaller printed Fresh Taste line, left of the large lettering in this view.
t3: terminal e of the smaller printed Fresh Taste line, toward the inward end of that line.

plane_quality.guard_provenance: At least the inherited guard and twice each observed fit RMS; never reduced during refinement. Operational allowance, not a calibrated confidence interval.
plane_quality.scope: Plane support only; does not authorize alignment, descent or closure.

model.scope: Only the observed local wall strips; no global collision certificate.

result.explanation: Alternatives 0 (+88), 1 (-88), 2 (+90), and 3 (-90): the high, empty, open-hand alignments are clear within the visible local workspace, separately from descent. The package and counter lie below that high sweep; the bowl is lateral to it. All four descents are blocked: turning the visible bulky palm sideways places its lower extent below the counter before the pads reach the proposed low wall-contact height. Reversing the tilt sign moves the palm to the other longitudinal side but does not remove this counter obstruction. The finger-only height intervals and outer-span margins do not establish palm clearance or an unobstructed inner aperture.

parameters.notes: Clear applies only to high local alignment, not lowering or closure. The package top is about 18 mm above the counter; the visible palm thickness cannot fit that side-entry height. Some inner finger surfaces and the package's near end are robot-occluded, not observed external obstructions; hidden clearance is not certified. Regions sample visible palm, counter, package and bowl surfaces. Earlier image frames are not present here; historical measurements are not additional views.
